name: full-game-real-ui-controls
description: Drive 25 current player-facing HUD/menu controls through coupled real mouse gestures. Every intended gesture uses the same exact segmented instance path on both moves and the balanced left-button down/60ms/up pair so the runner resolves one fresh cached coordinate; each control is >=44 px, Active, Selectable, viewport-visible, topmost, callback-attested, and followed by bounded client/request/authoritative evidence without hidden retries. Rare filtering uses owned Iron Knuckle and must exclude the two owned Common fists. Settings gestures use the current standalone window and exact semantic options. Screen visibility compares AbsolutePosition plus GuiInset against the raw viewport; native input and GetGuiObjectsAtPosition retain the original AbsolutePosition coordinates, including valid negative top coordinates.
